set.description: 会用平方运算求完全平方数的平方根，了解 √(a²)=|a|，并能用计算器求近似值。
set.name: Finding Square Roots
set.nameZh: 开平方与平方根的求法

set.description: 两角分别相等；两边成比例且夹角相等；三边成比例的两个三角形相似。
set.name: Criteria for Similar Triangles

criteria: 能用性质求周长与面积
set.description: 相似三角形对应角相等、对应边成比例，对应高、中线、角平分线之比及周长之比等于相似比，面积之比等于相似比的平方。
set.name: Properties of Similar Triangles

criteria: 能添加平行线构造相似
set.description: 识别“A 型”“8 字型”“母子型（射影）”等相似基本图形并用于证明和计算。
set.name: Basic Models of Similar Triangles
set.nameZh: 相似三角形的基本模型

set.description: 把方程一边化为 0，另一边分解成一次因式的积，利用“若 ab=0 则 a=0 或 b=0”求解。
set.name: Factoring Method
scopeNotes: Factoring here is an equation-solving procedure, not the entire factor-sign method for inequalities.

set.description: 四条线段 a、b、c、d 满足 a/b=c/d 叫成比例线段，掌握比例的基本性质与合比等变形。
set.name: Proportional Line Segments

set.description: 直角三角形两直角边的平方和等于斜边的平方：a²+b²=c²。
set.name: Pythagorean theorem

set.description: (a±b)²=a²±2ab+b²，可用图形面积解释。
set.name: Perfect Square Formula

set.description: 等式两边同加（减）同一个数或式，或同乘（除以）同一个不为 0 的数，等式仍成立。
set.name: Properties of Equality

set.reason: The theorem's third-side computation requires taking a nonnegative square root of a sum or difference of squares.
set.scope: computing the third side from two sides

set.reason: Subsidiary triangle similarity proves height/median ratios; direct property use is a different route.
set.scope: proving ratios of heights, medians, bisectors

set.reason: Model computations mostly use proportional corresponding sides, already given by the definition. Perimeter, area and height ratio properties help in richer problems but are not essential.
set.scope: computations within basic models

set.reason: The recurring configurations must be recognized and justified by a similarity test.
set.scope: proving similarity in A, 8, mother-child models
